geography.notes: Energy Trust offers apply in participating Oregon electric utility territory; some equity offers are limited to qualifying affordable housing, nonprofit, tribal, or community-serving business customers.

hardRequirements: Project must be served by a participating Oregon electric utility, generally Portland General Electric or Pacific Power.
Customer and site must meet Energy Trust eligibility and equity-program participation requirements.

blockers: Do not match to general HVAC, weatherization, lighting, appliance, or non-solar energy efficiency measures.
